message: player_6, I'm not claiming a role but I was the one who watched you on night 2. Only player_4 and player_8 came to your door, so the visit by player_8 is the one that doesn't fit a no-visit claim from you, and player_8 is dead now. Which of those two do you say you were, if either?

As I said, night 1 I watched nobody. Night 2 my watch on player_6 showed only player_4 and player_8 at their door. player_1, that's all I have, and it doesn't clear anyone by itself. player_6, you still haven't said who you went to that night.

player_6, I checked nobody on night 1. My only check was you on night 2, and it read Suspicious. player_9's watch shows me at your door, so that matches. Your no-visit claim is the thing to answer now: who did you go to that night?

player_9, I never checked player_8. My only check was player_6 on night 2, which read Suspicious, and I held on night 1. Your watch matches my visit, so I'm not doubting you yet. player_6, you still haven't said what you did on night 2, so explain why you were at home that night.

player_6, you were at no door? Fine, but my watch showed two visitors at yours, and you still haven't said who you went to on night 2. Answer that directly, player_4 has said they were at your door, so you're the one leaving it open.

As I said, night 1 I watched nobody, so my only result is night 2 on player_6. player_4 and player_8 came to their door. player_6, my watch only shows who came to you, so your denial doesn't clear you either way. player_4, your check on 6 fits that visit, so I'd like to hear from others before weighing it.

I'm the speculator and I picked Town, so I have every reason to find the necromancer. player_2, you named me on a chain that doesn't hold: a visit to player_7 doesn't tell us whether player_3 did it. What did you do on nights 3 and 4?

Be careful, everyone: with three alive, any death now leaves two, and two is a win for the necromancer. So a wrong lynch loses the game. Player_3 and player_10, one of you is the necromancer. Each of you say which role you are and what you did on night 4, and let's compare what fits the other roles still out.

I did nothing on night 4 or 5, so I can't say who went to player_7. player_2, you were wrong to call player_3 clear on a watch that only shows who came to player_3. Since the necromancer is one of you two, player_3, what did you do on night 4?

player_6, I checked you on night 2, not night 1, and I checked nobody on night 1. player_9's watch shows me at your door, which is exactly that check. You still haven't said where you went that night. Your no-visit claim doesn't explain why you voted player_2 without a reason either.

player_6, you say you visited nobody on night 2, but player_9's watch put two visitors at your door. Your answer to player_9 is the only thing on the table that doesn't match, so give a straight account of what you did that night. Nobody has yet explained the abstain-first pattern, so I'd like player_1, player_3, player_7 and player_10 to say what they think of the two claims.

player_4, my point was that the watch shows who came to me, so the sentinel's result is about visitors, not a clearance. A Suspicious read on me doesn't tell us which of you is lying. Which night did you check me, and what did you do on night 1?

player_2, fair question: I voted you on day 2 because you piled on early, and I'll own that. As I said, I visited no one on night 2. player_4 and player_9, what did your night 1 results show, if anything?

player_9, you were roleblocked on night 3, so the chanteuse chose you that night. Players who had a night 3 action that was blocked should say so. Whoever was blocked and whoever was not gives us a way to narrow the chanteuse. I'm not voting yet.

player_9 says night 3 was roleblocked, which means a chanteuse chose a target that night. That claim cannot be checked by anyone, so I would not let it decide the vote. Night 2 is the only watch we can compare with player_4's check. I would abstain today until someone adds a test.

Open floor from me: player_2's watch and player_8's protection visit both put player_8 at player_5 on night 2, so that's the one checkable overlap. player_8, if you protected player_5, did they report being blocked? I'm voting player_8 today because that visit has no result attached, but I'm open to changing if player_2's watch shows something else.

player_8, you now say your night-2 visit to player_5 was protection, which is a healer claim you have not made outright. But player_5 says they were blocked, and a blocked player gets no protection. Which is it, and what did player_2's watch show about who came to player_5?

I'm the sentinel. Night 1 I watched player_4 and no one visited them. Night 2 I watched player_5 and saw player_7 and player_8 come to them. player_8, player_3's will says player_7 blocked you on night 1, so what did you do that night and did it take? Until a claim breaks I'd vote player_6, who hasn't claimed anything.

player_4, I'm not sure player_5 was blocked on night 2. The only chanteuse, player_7, was struck that night, so you can't assume their block took. My night-2 protection went to player_5 and no attack was announced there. Vote me if you like, but name the check that makes player_6 or player_10 the killer first.

player_6, I checked nobody on night 1 and did nothing. My only check was you on night 2, and it read Suspicious. You say you visited nobody, but that doesn't clear you against my result. Let's vote on you unless someone gives a real reason not to.

As I said, night 1 I watched nobody. My only result is night 2 on player_6, where player_4 and player_8 came to their door. That doesn't prove player_6 visited anyone, since a watch only shows who came in. player_4, your check on player_6 is the claim to test, so what did you do on night 1?

player_9, on night 2 I checked only player_6, so I learned nothing about player_8, and I held on night 1. player_6, you say you went nowhere that night, so who came to you? player_9's watch on you should show that.

player_6, my watch only shows who came to you, so I can't confirm you visited no one, and I can't confirm you were at anyone's door. The only fact I have is that player_4 and player_8 came to you on night 2. player_4 says they were there; if not you, then who visited your house from the other side?

player_2, your night 4 point doesn't clear player_3: player_9's watch only shows no one visited player_3, and says nothing about what player_3 did. What did you do on nights 4 and 5, and who did you check or watch?

Night 4 I watched player_3 and nobody visited them, so their night was quiet to me. player_2 and player_10, what did you do last night, and who did you go to? Whoever reads as the Necromancer will have a body or a visit that doesn't fit the others' accounts.

As I said, night 1 I watched nobody. My only result is night 2 on player_6: player_4 and player_8 came to their door. player_6, you say no one came to you, but the watch shows two visitors. Why do you think I would get that wrong, and who do you think went to you?

Night 5 someone blocked a player through player_1's body, and only the necromancer can do that. So one of player_3 or player_10 is the necromancer and still active. I have no vote yet. player_3, player_10: tell me what you did on night 4 and 5, and whether you visited anyone.

player_6, to your question: I watched nobody on night 1, and on night 2 I watched you. Only player_4 and player_8 came to your door. My watch can't show where you went, but player_8 was at your door that night and was killed that night. player_6, who do you think they were visiting?

I visited nobody on night 4 or 5, same as before, and I have no role that acts at night. You asked who I think the necromancer is: I can't tell yet. You called player_3 clear on a watch that couldn't show it, so ask yourself what you actually know about night 4 apart from that.

Night 1 I held and checked nobody. Night 2 I checked you, player_6, and got Suspicious. player_9's watch has me at your door, so your no-visit claim doesn't hold. Who did you actually go to that night?

I'm not claiming a role, and I won't walk through my night here. player_4, you say your Suspicious read on me is solid, so what made you pick me on night 2 over the others? player_9, what did your watch show on night 1?

player_2, I voted you on day 2 because I wanted a lynch with a reason on the table, and I'll own that. I went nowhere on night 2, as I said. player_4 and player_9 both put me at a door, so I want to hear their night 1 results before anything else.

player_9's watch has player_8 at player_6's door on night 2, and player_8 is now dead with a hidden role. player_6, if you went nowhere that night, who was player_8 visiting? I'd vote player_6 today for that reason, unless someone gives a clearer answer.

player_9 says player_8 came to player_6 on night 2, so player_8 was an active role, not a silent one. player_6 denies any visit that night, which conflicts with that watch. I'm holding my vote until one of the investigator or sentinel claims gets a second check.

player_9, a night 3 roleblock means a living chanteuse blocked you, and chanteuse blocks only hit town. So you are probably town, and the chanteuse is alive and not you. Nobody has said who blocked whom on night 3, so that is worth pressing. I have no vote to give yet.

Player_4's will confirms they checked player_6 on night 2, which matches player_9's watch on that door. That makes player_9's night 2 account the most solid thing we have. Night 3 being a roleblock points at the Chanteuse, not at player_9 lying. I'd hold my vote until someone gives a concrete night 3 account.

My sigil on player_7 struck them as they attacked, so that part is solid. player_2's watch and player_8's visit to player_5 line up, but neither is checkable yet. player_6, what did you do last night? I'd rather hear a result than vote on silence.

player_8, if you protected on night 2, who did you protect? Your visit to player_5 is the only protection claim on the table, and player_5 says they were blocked, so there's no save to check. I'd vote player_6 for now: they haven't claimed or answered anything yet, and everyone else has a claim we can check.

Both wolves are dead, so the killer is one of the five living players other than me. Sentinel, sigilist, investigator and a protection visit are all claimed, and player_6 is the only one with no claim. player_6, what did you do on nights 1 and 2? I'm abstaining for now.

player_4, my blocked night was night 1, when player_5 was blocked, so no protection went ahead then. Last night, night 2, I protected player_5 and no save was announced. Your sigil on player_7 matches the record, but I won't vote for someone whose only pressure is a claim I can't check yet.
